name: grayout
description: Your Mac goes gray until you get back to work.
author: Aarush Kandukoori

scripts.check: for f in main.js src/*.js ui/*.js ui/preload/*.js build/afterSign.js scripts/*.js electron-builder.mas.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.pack: npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.mas:dev: npm run helper && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mas.cjs --mac mas-dev --arm64 --publish never && bash scripts/verify-mas.sh dist/mas-dev-arm64/Grayout.app
scripts.mas: npm run helper && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mas.cjs --mac mas --arm64 --publish never && bash scripts/verify-mas.sh dist/mas-arm64/Grayout.app "dist/mas-arm64/Grayout-$npm_package_version-mas.pkg"

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Only if you turn it on, Grayout sends one camera frame with each check to the Grayout service and OpenAI to notice a phone in your hand. Grayout never saves frames.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Grayout takes a screenshot of each display about every 45 seconds and sends it to the Grayout service, which uses OpenAI to decide whether you are clearly not working. Screenshots are deleted from this Mac right away and are never stored by Grayout.
